title: SettingsClient.testConnection / ipfsDesktop.agentSettings.testConnection
description: Messages of the SettingsClient.testConnection() method (agent-settings-contract task 1.5). On the Desktop bridge this is the IPC channel ipfsDesktop.agentSettings.testConnection; on HTTP it is POST on the test-connection endpoint (mcp-agent-settings-api 1.4). The check probes a candidate URL only: https, or http on loopback; credentials in the URL are rejected; nothing is persisted. A candidate key is never accepted in the request (assessment-ui 5.2's apiKey field is dropped for this reason): authentication, when needed, uses the currently stored key, on Desktop the key held in safeStorage by the main process. When the probe succeeds the implementation may also list models (HTTP: the model-list endpoint, ../model-list.schema.json; bridge: the same call through the sidecar) and return them in models, which is how the model combobox (assessment-ui 5.2) is populated without a separate IPC channel.

base_url.description: Candidate endpoint URL, mapping assessment-ui 5.2's url. https for any host; http only for loopback (localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]). No userinfo: a URL carrying credentials does not validate.

kind.description: Backend kind to probe as, mapping assessment-ui 5.2's backend. Absent means openai.

ok.description: Whether the candidate URL answered as the chosen backend kind within the bounded timeout.

detail.description: Why the check failed when ok is false; the UI renders this as the inline status line (role=status, assessment-ui 5.2). Never includes credentials or key material.

latency_ms.description: Round-trip time of the probe as measured by the client implementation, mapping assessment-ui 5.2's latencyMs. Informational; absent when the implementation does not measure it.

models.description: Model identifiers reported by the candidate backend, mapping assessment-ui 5.2's models. Present only after a successful probe when the implementation listed them via the model-list endpoint (../model-list.schema.json); absent on failure or when the backend hides its model list, in which case the combobox stays free-text.
